title: Nobody has slept in this $15M house since last summer
description: The most expensive houses in the world are heated, staffed and cleaned for an owner who shows up about four weeks a year. Follow the running costs and the price of a single night's sleep gets absurd.

scenes.narration: Nobody has slept in this house since last summer.
scenes.imagePrompt: Large modern clifftop luxury villa filling the frame on a bright summer afternoon, cantilevered travertine terraces and floor-to-ceiling glass, deep shade under the long roof overhangs, a still turquoise infinity pool along the near edge, empty terraces, deep blue Mediterranean sea and clear sky behind

scenes.narration: It is not abandoned. The pool is heated, the lawn is cut, the fridge is stocked.
scenes.imagePrompt: Infinity pool of a luxury villa at midday in summer, perfectly still turquoise water, a freshly mown lawn strip and clipped hedges beside it, empty teak sun loungers with folded white towels under the hard shadow of a wide parasol, the stone villa behind, sharp noon shadows across the deck

scenes.narration: In some resort towns, three houses in four sit empty out of season.
scenes.imagePrompt: Row of three large modern lakeside luxury villas on a sunny summer day seen from the water, flat roofs, pale stone and full-height glass facades, private timber docks with no boats moored, blinds closed behind the glass, a dark forested mountain filling the upper frame behind them, deep blue lake water lying in shadow across the foreground

scenes.narration: A fifteen-million-dollar villa is not a holiday home. It is a vault with a view.
scenes.imagePrompt: Single large modern beachfront luxury villa filling the frame at midday, one wide low storey under a long overhanging roof casting deep shade across the whole facade, floor-to-ceiling glass, infinity pool and teak deck directly in front, palm fronds hanging into the top corners of the frame, hard palm shadows striping the sand in the foreground

scenes.narration: Keeping it ready costs staff, security, insurance and tax, around four hundred thousand a year.
scenes.imagePrompt: Kitchen of a luxury villa on a summer morning, long book-matched marble island, dark lacquered joinery with brass handles, a row of copper pans, hard sunlight falling in bright bands through slatted shutters onto the marble, the rest of the room in deep shadow, no people

bigNumber.label: a year to keep it ready

scenes.narration: The owner stays about four weeks, split across the year.
scenes.imagePrompt: Master bedroom of a luxury sea-view villa on a bright summer day seen from the shaded side of the room, dark timber ceiling and a deep terrace overhang shading the foreground, wide made bed with crisp untouched white linen catching a single band of sunlight, floor-to-ceiling glass wall open onto a blue sea, deep shadow across the lower part of the frame

scenes.narration: That works out near fourteen thousand dollars a night, before anyone turns on a light.
scenes.imagePrompt: Covered terrace of a luxury villa at midday in summer, long stone dining table set for nobody with chairs pushed in, deep shade under a timber pergola, hard shadow bars from the pergola beams striping the table, bright sunlit pool and blue sea beyond the balustrade

scenes.narration: So the pool stays warm, the gate stays shut, and nobody has slept here since last summer.
scenes.imagePrompt: Wide summer daytime exterior of a large clifftop luxury villa seen from the sea side, stone terraces and glass walls in full sun, a still turquoise infinity pool, a closed gate and empty driveway to one side, deep blue sea below and clear sky above
